tests.detail: auth.uid() resolves to caller (20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002) — JWT identity trusted
request.headers GUC visible to SQL; credentials redacted in probe output
arbitrary client headers ARE visible as raw text; XFF arrives as client value + gateway-appended peer ("203.0.113.99, 172.20.0.1") — left hops untrusted, right-most gateway-asserted
inet_client_addr() inside PostgREST = "172.20.0.9" — the DB never sees the browser connection directly (PostgREST is the TCP peer)
SET LOCAL / set_config(...,true) dies at transaction end (post-commit value: post:<gone>)
session-level SET persists for the whole connection — DANGEROUS under pooling; any GUC mechanism must be transaction-local
transaction-local GUC visible within its request, gone on the next pooled request (next="" — placeholder quirk, no value leak)
trigger captured actor (auth.uid), firm, correlation/request id, XFF ("203.0.113.7, 172.20.0.1"), UA on a plain table write
spoofed x-actor-*/x-service-name/x-support-session headers IGNORED — actor stays auth.uid(), human
client-supplied XFF preserved verbatim + gateway-appended hop ("198.51.100.23, 172.20.0.1") — client portion SPOOFABLE, best-effort evidence only (AUD-CTX-02)
sequential A/B/A/B requests: zero cross-request context leakage (actor, firm, correlation all correct)
20 concurrent pooled requests: zero context leakage across users/firms
cross-firm insert (A user -> firm B context) denied by RLS (HTTP 403)
suspended and removed memberships denied on direct writes (live lookup)
overlap identity: client context requires live client grant; staff context uses membership; contexts do not inherit
RPC mutation+audit: actor derived from auth.uid(), firm live-validated, single audit row
caller-supplied actor keys in RPC payload rejected at API boundary (HTTP 404 — unknown args fail function resolution); actor can only derive from auth.uid()
RPC foreign-firm spoof rejected by live membership validation (HTTP 403: audctx: no live active membership for firm 10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002)
RPC suspended/removed memberships rejected (live lookup, not token state)
service actor: browser token DENIED (HTTP 403); service_role-only definer function writes actor_type=service, NULL user
support actor: valid open session writes actor+session id; another user's session and unknown sessions rejected
RPC client context validated against live client_access grant (CL-100 ok, CL-999 denied)
wrapper listening on 127.0.0.1:5499 (loopback only)
wrapper: token validated server-side, request_id generated server-side, IP observed by wrapper (127.0.0.1), RLS still enforced downstream
wrapper rejects missing and invalid tokens (401) before any DB work
caller spoof headers (x-actor-*, even the wrapper secret) cannot change identity on the human path
service path: secret-less call 403; server-side call writes actor_type=service with server-fixed service_name (browser can never reach service role)
wrapper foreign-firm attempt rejected downstream by live validation (HTTP 403)
A path: forced audit-write failure rolled back the resource mutation in the same transaction (0 rows, 0 events)
B path: masquerading audit row rejected (HTTP 403); mutation+audit failed atomically — fail-closed verified
actor-model CHECK (AUD-ACT-05): system+actor_user_id rejected even for privileged writers; legitimate system seed row intact

actor_type.B: IGNORED — human via RPC; service only via service_role function (B-05)
actor_type.C: IGNORED on human path; service path server-secret gated (C-04)

firm_id.A: VALIDATED — RLS live lookup, foreign firm denied (A-06)
